remarks: Welcome to 273 Sylvan Knolls - A Bright and Beautiful End-Unit Townhouse! Move right into this updated, sun-drenched 2-bedroom, 1.5-bath home, perfectly situated in a serene and convenient Stamford location. This charming end unit features a spacious eat-in kitchen, a finished lower level with a dedicated laundry room, and direct access to parking just outside your back door. Enjoy the outdoors with space to relax or entertain, and take advantage of the beautifully maintained grounds, complete with walking paths, a private playground, and a welcoming community atmosphere. Live just a short stroll from Cove Beach, Holly Pond, and Chelsea Piers, with easy access to I-95 and the train-making commuting a breeze. This home truly offers the best of comfort, convenience, and coastal living!
